fallDamage.title: Fall Damage Calculator
fallDamage.block.other: All blocks except those listed below
fallDamage.block.none: Water, Cobweb, Honey Block side, Sweet Berry Bush, Powder Snow, Bubble Column or climbing a Ladder, Vines, Scaffolding, Weeping Vines, Twisting Vines, Cave Vines
fallDamage.levelHint: The value must be a integer between 0 and 255
fallDamage.zeroReverseNote: The fall height calculated here is the highest height at which fall damage is fully negated with the current configuration.
fallDamage.immuneNote: With the current configuration, fall damage is completely negated; any fall height results in 0 fall damage.
fallDamage.lavaPath: Fall path (Air, then Lava, in order from top to bottom; the ground lies directly below the last Lava layer):
fallDamage.lavaNoReverse: When falling into lava, the damage is not monotonic with respect to the fall height, so the fall height cannot be derived from the damage.
